sections.Profile:
"Tri-Score," released by Genco Manufacturing Co. in December 1950, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine. The playfield features two flippers, two pop bumpers, eight rollover buttons, and five kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1951
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Original Theme
